tax.title: Tax & Declarations
tax.subtitle: Payroll tax (loonbelasting), AOV and statutory declarations — prepared from approved payroll.
tax.rulesPending: The statutory rules in use are pending legal verification. Calculations and declarations are marked “pending legal validation” and cannot be approved without an explicit acknowledgement.
tax.dashboardSub: Monthly return “loonbelasting en premie AOV”. Drafts are prepared automatically when payroll is approved.
tax.howSub: ARA Payroll prepares the declaration; you submit it yourself through the official channel.

how.1: Review the draft and approve it — the files are generated (PDF, Excel, CSV).
how.2: Download the declaration and the supporting schedules.
how.3: File the monthly return for loonbelasting and AOV premium in the online portal of the Belastingdienst (filing window reported as the 26th to the 10th of the following month — verify).
how.4: Record the submission date and reference in ARA Payroll and upload the receipt.
how.5: Record acceptance and payment when confirmed. ARA Payroll never marks a declaration as submitted on its own.

tax.aovIntro: AOV is reported separately from payroll tax. Under the researched rules the premium is withheld from the employee; any employer share is an employer obligation and is never deducted from net pay.

legalRegister.intro: Legal sources register. Statuses reflect what could be confirmed; nothing here replaces review by a qualified tax professional. Verify later decrees and official instructions before production use.
legalRegister.researchNote: Last checked on 3 November 2026. The official websites (gov.sr, sris.sr, dna.sr, belastingdienst.sr, fvo.sr) could not be opened directly from the research environment; findings are based on excerpts of those official pages and on secondary sources. Therefore no rule is marked as fully verified.

extraSub.ALLOWANCE: Incidental allowances for this payslip only, such as a bonus or gratuity.
extraSub.DEDUCTION: Incidental deductions for this payslip only. Wage tax and AOV are calculated automatically.

compose.finaliseText: A payslip becomes final when the payroll run is approved. After that amounts can no longer be changed and historical payslips remain unchanged.

contrib.intro: For each scheme you record an employee contribution (deducted from salary) and an employer contribution (employer costs, never deducted from net pay). Change rates from a date with a new version so historical payslips stay unchanged.
contrib.noInventedRates: ARA Payroll never prefills percentages or amounts. Configure the rates, base and legal applicability yourself and have statutory schemes verified.

typeHint.HEALTH: Employee and employer contribution to health insurance.
typeHint.PENSION: Employee and employer contribution to the pension scheme. An active scheme replaces the pension percentage of the employment contract (never both).

basisHint.STATUTORY: Statutory obligation: rates and base must be legally verified.
basisHint.VOLUNTARY: Employment-condition scheme under contract, collective agreement or rules.

contrib.noneActive: There are no active schemes. An administrator can set them up under Settings → Contributions.
contrib.employeeShareHint: Deducted from salary; reduces net pay.
contrib.employerShareHint: Added to employer costs; never deducted from net pay.

f.name: Scheme name
f.currencyHint: Currency of fixed amounts and the maximum base
f.employeeTax: Tax treatment of the employee contribution
f.showOnPayslip: Show the employer contribution on the payslip
f.showOnPayslipHint: The employee contribution is always on the payslip; the employer contribution always counts towards employer costs.

contrib.statutoryWarning: Statutory scheme: rates, base and split are not verified in ARA Payroll. A payroll run with an unverified scheme is marked 'pending legal validation'.
contrib.versionSub: Creates a draft version with a new start date. The current version keeps applying until the new version is approved; finalised pay periods remain unchanged.
contrib.versionCreated: Draft version created. Adjust the rates, save and approve; the previous version keeps applying until approval.
contrib.employeeTabSub: Health insurance, pension and FVO: the employee contribution is deducted, the employer contribution is added to employer costs.
contrib.contractPensionIgnored: The pension percentage of the employment contract is not applied while the scheme “{name}” applies (no double deduction).
contrib.enrollmentRemoved: Individual arrangement removed; the scheme default applies again.
contrib.lookalikes: Check these custom components: they look like health insurance, pension or FVO and are not recognised automatically as the same contribution: {list}. End them when the scheme deducts the same contribution, to avoid double deductions.

issue.NOT_CONFIGURED: No employee or employer rate set
issue.AWAITING_APPROVAL: Rates set but not yet approved

contrib.validationSub: Which schemes are active, inactive or incompletely configured, and whether payroll runs can be finalised.
contrib.payrollBlocked: Payroll runs for {period} cannot be finalised: the statutory scheme(s) {list} have not been configured and approved. Set the rates based on verified regulations and approve them, or mark the scheme as not applicable.
contrib.payrollReady: All statutory schemes for {period} are configured and approved or marked as not applicable.
contrib.savedDraft: Scheme saved as a draft. An owner or administrator must approve the rates before the scheme is used.
contrib.savedNeedsApproval: Scheme saved. The rates changed: the scheme has been deactivated until it is approved again.
contrib.changeResetsApproval: Note: changing rates or calculation settings deactivates the scheme until an owner or administrator approves the new rates.
contrib.statusSub: A scheme is only used in payroll once its rates are set and approved and the scheme is active.
contrib.approveConfirm: Do you confirm that the rates and base are based on verified regulations or the applicable scheme rules?
contrib.approveOnlyAdmin: Only an owner or administrator can approve the rates and activate the scheme.
contrib.deactivateConfirm: The scheme will no longer be used in new calculations. Continue?
contrib.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the employer is not covered by this scheme under …
contrib.notApplicableHint: Only use this when it is established that the scheme does not apply to this company. The decision and reason are recorded in the audit log.
contrib.markedApplicable: {name} applies again and must be configured and approved.
contrib.fvoNotice: FVO: the legal basis is {status}. According to official publications the premium is 1% of the basic monthly wage (excluding allowances and emoluments), with an employee share of at most half; the premium article in the law has not been verified yet. The FVO scheme stays inactive until an administrator has verified the official basis and approved the rates.
contrib.seeLegalSources: See the findings in Legal sources
contrib.pensionByContract: Pension: every employee has a pension percentage in the employment contract. This covers the statutory pension obligation for payroll; a pension scheme is not required.
contrib.statutoryNeedsVerification: A statutory scheme can only be approved and activated once its legal status is 'Verified': check the official text (Staatsblad) and record the source.
